subject: Invoice sender decision + VAT tagging requirements for monthly billing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Lucia Garza <lgarza@novus.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Invoice sender decision + VAT tagging requirements for monthly billing

Hi Lucia —

Quick question as we prepare your billing onboarding: for Novus’ monthly invoices do you want Redwood to:

1) Push invoices directly to your AP portal (SFTP/API push) as the canonical delivery channel, with an email copy to apac-payments@novus.com as backup, or
2) Continue sending a consolidated PDF by email to apac-payments@novus.com and the billing contact each month?

Two follow-ups we need to confirm either way:
- VAT tagging: do you require the EU VAT field on each invoice line (VAT ID + reverse-charge flag) or is a single header-level VAT number sufficient?
- PO handling: should we put PO# in the invoice subject line or in an invoice field? Your AP team's preference will change our template.

I attached a small XML sample of our invoice payload (sample_invoice_v2.xml) so your AP integration team can confirm field names. If portal push is preferred we’ll schedule a short test push next week.

Proposed next step: if you confirm portal push, we’ll set up a one-hour integration window and provide an AX/field map. If email-only, we’ll confirm the subject format and include VAT certificate on file.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: sample_invoice_v2.xml

From: Lucia Garza <lgarza@novus.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: apac-payments@novus.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice sender decision + VAT tagging requirements for monthly billing

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. Novus AP prefers option 1 (portal push) for automated reconciliation; we can accept email PDF copies only as a fallback for the first two months while the portal mapping is validated.

VAT: we require VAT ID at the invoice header and a per-line reverse-charge boolean for services for EU customers. Our tax team will provide the VAT format. Here is our AP inbox and the contact for mapping questions: apac-payments@novus.com (please cc).

POs: put PO# in the invoice subject and in the PO_number field in the payload. That makes our matching >95% accurate.

I attached Novus_VAT_certificate.pdf for your records. For the portal push we need a sample push and an agreed-to delivery window (daily batch between 02:00–04:00 UTC works).

Best,
Lucia Garza
Senior AP Manager, Novus Health
lgarza@novus.com

Attachments: Novus_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Invoice sender decision + VAT tagging requirements for monthly billing

Kim / Marissa —

Forwarding Lucia's confirmation from Novus. TL;DR: they want portal push as canonical with email fallback for two months; VAT header + per-line reverse-charge required; PO in subject + PO_number field. They asked for a sample push during 02:00–04:00 UTC daily.

Action items I propose: 
- Marissa: schedule a 45–60m integration test with Novus AP next Tue (please invite engineering and our payments infra). Share API spec + sample push payload (I attached sample_invoice_v2.xml).
- Kimberly: confirm we’ll include PO# in subject line and adjust our monthly subject template to: "Invoice Redwood - <Account> - <YYYYMM> - PO <PO#>". Also confirm fallback email copy goes to apac-payments@novus.com.

If you both approve I’ll lock the time with Lucia and add HS:567890 to the ticket.

Thanks,
Jordan
